text.p: British bookmakers installed the romantic desert epic "The English Patient" on Tuesday as red-hot favourite to win the coveted Best Film Oscar at next week's glittering Academy Awards ceremony in Hollywood. They made the film, which has garnered 12 Oscar nominations, 6-1 on favourite. "Shine", the story of an Australian pianist suffering from a mental breakdown, was a distant second choice at 11-2.

"This is the shortest priced favourite I can remember," said Simon Clare, spokesman for the bookmakers Ladbrokes. "We have had about 50,000 pounds ($80,000) wagered in bets. Several of them are people working within the film industry."

Geoffrey Rush, the fast-talking star of "Shine," is 13-8 on favourite to be named best male actor on March 24. Frances McDormand, the star of "Fargo", was the 9-4 on choice for the Best Actress Award.
